tools.name: payspace_list_companies
tools.description: List the companies (id, code, name, group) the API credentials can access. Company ids go into the company_id argument of the other tools. From the token reply of POST /connect/token.

tools.name: payspace_list_employees
tools.description: List active employees of a company with their biographical details (name, employee number, contact, dates). Personal data. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/Employee. Use payspace_list_all_employees to include terminated employees.

tools.name: payspace_list_all_employees
tools.description: List all employees of a company including terminated ones. Personal data. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/Employee/all.

tools.name: payspace_get_employee
tools.description: Get one employee's biographical record by EmployeeId (the numeric id from payspace_list_employees). Personal data. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/Employee({id}).

tools.name: payspace_list_employee_positions
tools.description: List employee position records (job, organization unit, grade, manager, effective dates). GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeePosition.

tools.name: payspace_list_employment_statuses
tools.description: List employee employment status records (hire, termination, reason, dates). GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeeEmploymentStatus.

tools.name: payspace_list_suspensions
tools.description: List employee suspension records. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeeSuspension.

tools.name: payspace_list_organization_units
tools.description: List the organization hierarchy units (departments, divisions, cost centres) of a company. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/OrganizationUnit.

tools.name: payspace_list_organization_positions
tools.description: List the organization positions (position details) defined for a company. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/OrganizationPositionDetail.

tools.name: payspace_list_jobs
tools.description: List the jobs defined in job management for a company. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/JobManagement.

tools.name: payspace_list_regions
tools.description: List the company's regions. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/CompanyRegion.

tools.name: payspace_list_payroll_frequencies
tools.description: List the payroll frequencies of a company (the CompanyFrequency lookup). A value goes into the frequency argument of payspace_list_payroll_components, payspace_list_payroll_runs and payspace_list_recurring_components. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/Lookup/CompanyFrequency.

tools.name: payspace_list_payroll_runs
tools.description: List the payroll runs (periods) of a company for one frequency (the CompanyRun lookup). A value goes into the period argument of payspace_list_payroll_components and payspace_list_recurring_components. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/Lookup/CompanyRun?frequency=.

tools.name: payspace_list_payroll_components
tools.description: List the company's payroll components (earnings, deductions, contributions) with their codes, for one payroll frequency and run. Get frequency from payspace_list_payroll_frequencies and period from payspace_list_payroll_runs. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/ComponentCompany?frequency=&period=.

tools.name: payspace_list_recurring_components
tools.description: List the recurring payroll components (EmployeeComponent) or loans (EmployeeLoan) of ONE employee for a payroll frequency and run. Personal data (pay). Get frequency from payspace_list_payroll_frequencies and period from payspace_list_payroll_runs. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/{entity}?frequency=&perio

tools.name: payspace_list_payslips
tools.description: List employee payslips (totals per employee) for a calendar year and month. Personal data (pay). GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeePayslip/{year}/{month}.

tools.name: payspace_list_payslip_lines
tools.description: List the payslip lines (one per component per employee: code, description, amount) for a calendar year and month. Personal data (pay). GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeePayslipLine/{year}/{month}.

tools.name: payspace_list_leave_applications
tools.description: List employee leave applications (type, dates, days, status). Give year and month together to restrict to a period. Personal data (absence). GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeeLeaveApplication[/{year}/{month}].

tools.name: payspace_list_leave_adjustments
tools.description: List employee leave adjustments (manual changes to leave balances). Personal data. GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeeLeaveAdjustment.

tools.name: payspace_list_leave_entitlements
tools.description: List employee leave setup entitlements (leave type, days per cycle). GET /odata/v2.0/{company}/EmployeeLeaveSetupEntitlement.

tools.name: payspace_list_records
tools.description: List records of another read-only entity set: CompanyEmploymentCategory, CompanyEmploymentSubCategory, CompanyLeaveReason, CompanyPositionFamily, CompanyPositionFunctionArea, CompanyTrainingCourse, CompanyQualification, CostingProjectActivity, OrganizationGrade, EmployeeAsset, EmployeeClaim, Employe

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "payspace_list_companies" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: payspace_list_companies · Private data: payspace_list_companies, payspace_list_employees, payspace_get_employee, payspace_list_employee_positions, payspace_list_employment_statuses, payspace_list_suspensions, payspace_list_records · Public sink: payspace_list_companies · Destructive: payspace_list_payroll_components, payspace_list_recurring_components.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: payspace_list_companies · Private data: payspace_list_companies, payspace_list_employees, payspace_get_employee, payspace_list_employee_positions, payspace_list_employment_statuses, payspace_list_suspensions, payspace_list_records · Public sink: payspace_list_companies · Destructive: payspace_list_payroll_components, payspace_list_recurring_components

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
